title: DISPOSITION v1 list_pending request
description: internal/server/disposition.ListPendingRequest. Every field is optional -- an empty object lists every pending/deferred item, ungrouped, from the start.

group.description: Collapse items sharing a non-empty group_id into one row carrying every member.

parked.description: List parked items instead of the default pending/deferred view -- the two are mutually exclusive.

cursor.description: Opaque page cursor from a prior response's next_cursor.
